articles.title: ONTAP 9.11: Multi-Admin Verification (MAV) introduced
articles.alignment: Enable: security multi-admin-verify modify -approval-groups <group> -enabled true

articles.title: ONTAP 9.12: TSSE default-on for AFF C-Series
articles.alignment: Changes efficiency ratio reporting — verify capacity dashboards: storage aggregate show -fields efficiency-data-reduction

articles.title: ONTAP 9.13: ARP for FlexGroup volumes
articles.alignment: Enable: security anti-ransomware volume enable — all cluster nodes must be 9.13.1+

articles.title: ONTAP 9.14: NVMe/TCP GA for SAN workloads
articles.alignment: Requires NVMe-oF host driver — configure: vserver nvme subsystem create

articles.title: ONTAP 9.15: SnapMirror active sync symmetric active/active for all-SAN
articles.alignment: Requires ASA or AFF SAN-only volumes — transparent failover <15s: snapmirror show -fields active-sync-status

articles.title: ONTAP 9.16: ARP/AI zero-learning ML ransomware detection
articles.alignment: Enable on all NAS volumes: security anti-ransomware volume enable -vserver <svm> -volume <vol> -state active

articles.title: ONTAP 9.17: AFX platform GA — minimum ONTAP for AFX 1K and AFX 2K
articles.alignment: AFX requires 9.17.1+, REST-only API (no ZAPI), NX224 shelves with NSM140 only

articles.title: ONTAP 9.18: SnapMirror cloud for MetroCluster FlexGroup volumes
articles.alignment: Enable: snapmirror create -type XDP -source-path <svm:vol> -destination-path <cloud-target>

articles.title: ONTAP 9.7: FabricPool for all platforms
articles.alignment: Enable cold data tiering: storage aggregate object-store config create -object-store-name <name>

articles.title: StorageGRID 12.1: 12 TB/s aggregate throughput (400% vs 12.0)
articles.alignment: Validate network bandwidth for upgraded throughput: grid topology show

articles.title: StorageGRID 12.0: StorageGRID 12.0 GA architecture refresh
articles.alignment: Major version upgrade — backup Grid Manager configuration before upgrading

articles.title: StorageGRID 11.9: S3 Select support for Parquet
articles.alignment: Query objects server-side without full download — configure via bucket policy

articles.title: SANtricity 12.0: SANtricity 12.0 GA for EF50/EF80 NVMe arrays
articles.alignment: Required for new-gen NVMe: 110+ GB/s read, 1.5PB capacity, AI/ML scratch workloads

articles.title: SANtricity 11.90: Enhanced volume snapshots for E-Series
articles.alignment: Point-in-time copies: SANtricity System Manager > Storage > Snapshots

articles.title: SANtricity 11.80: E-Series REST API GA
articles.alignment: Migrate from Symbol/SMcli to REST: https://<controller>/devmgr/v2
